title: HELIX JobClassification Resource
description: A job classification — the job profile/code with EEO/SOC classification and, for faculty, academic rank, tenure status, and IPEDS faculty category. Documents the recommended approach for faculty data Workday lacks natively.

helix_id.description: HELIX-assigned unique identifier for this JobClassification record.

job_code.description: Direct map. The institution's job code.

job_title.description: Direct map. E.g., 'Professor of Computer Science'.

eeo_category.description: Map to IPEDS/EEO categories: 'Executive/Admin/Managerial', 'Faculty', 'Other Professional', 'Technical/Paraprofessional', 'Clerical/Secretarial', 'Skilled Crafts', 'Service/Maintenance'.

soc_code.description: Standard Occupational Classification code. E.g., '25-1021' for CS professors.

cip_code.description: Classification of Instructional Programs code. Relevant for faculty to link to academic discipline. E.g., '11.0101' for Computer Science.

tenure_date.description: Date tenure was granted. Null if not tenured. Cast to ISO 8601.

ipeds_faculty_category.description: For IPEDS HR survey: 'Tenured', 'On Tenure Track', 'Not on Tenure Track/Multi-Year Contract', 'Not on Tenure Track/Annual Contract', 'Not on Tenure Track/Less Than Annual'. Cross-reference with FTE and function.

flsa_status.description: Map: true → 'exempt', false → 'non_exempt'. Faculty are typically exempt.

meta.description: HELIX metadata block — present on every resource.
